explanation: From main (PR #85): resolveGeneCI and compareCell take an optional rename table: after exact and case matches, a column is read under another member of the gene rename group in its own stored-symbol authority, chosen by pickStoredMember. CompareGenesView reads the table with useSymbolRenames and compareSummaryRows accepts it as an option. The Compare tab's downloads take the same table: CompareTab passes useSymbolRenames to compareGenesWorkbook, compareGenesCsv, compareValuesCsv (through compareSummaryLongRows and compareValueRows) and the chart ZIP, so a tile measured under a renamed symbol is never a 'Detected: no' row, a missing sample or a missing chart in the file. From this branch: resolveGeneCI and compareCell take an optional rename table: after exact and case matches, a column is read under another member of the gene rename group in its own stored-symbol authority, chosen by pickStoredMember. CompareGenesView reads the table with useSymbolRenames and compareSummaryRows accepts it as an option. Review fixes: the Compare tab passes the rename table to compareGenesWorkbook, compareGenesCsv, compareValuesCsv and its chart ZIP, whose long-format builders take it as a trailing argument, so downloads match the screen. In the merge with main, the Compare tab keeps main's single rename-table read for its downloads (PR #85's version), which this branch's duplicate declaration repeated.
